Telecommunications Engineering Specialists

About the Role
Design or configure wired, wireless, and satellite communications systems for voice, video, and data services. Supervise installation, service, and maintenance.
What You'll Do
Develop disaster recovery plans.
Develop or recommend network security measures, such as firewalls, network security audits, or automated security probes.
Develop and implement solutions for network problems.
Maintain networks by performing activities such as file addition, deletion, or backup.
Coordinate network operations, maintenance, repairs, or upgrades.
Coordinate installation of new equipment.
Monitor and analyze network performance and reports on data input or output to detect problems, identify inefficient use of computer resources, or perform capacity planning.
Develop network-related documentation.
Develop and write procedures for installation, use, or troubleshooting of communications hardware or software.
Participate in network technology upgrade or expansion projects, including installation of hardware and software and integration testing.


Tools & Technology
Access software: Access management software
Development environment software: Adobe ActionScript, Apache Ant, Apache Kafka
Video creation and editing software: Adobe After Effects
Object or component oriented development software: Advanced business application programming ABAP, Apache Groovy
Network monitoring software: AirMagnet Enterprise
Web platform development software: AJAX
Data base management system software: Amazon DynamoDB, Apache Cassandra, Apache Hadoop, Apache Hive
Data base user interface and query software: Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud EC2, Amazon Redshift, Amazon Web Services AWS software
Storage networking software: Amazon Simple Storage Service S3
Cloud-based management software: Amazon Web Services AWS CloudFormation
Expert system software: Ansible software
Portal server software: Apache HTTP Server
Education & Experience
Education: Bachelor's degree or Post-secondary certificate
On-the-Job Training: 6 months to 1 year
Related Work Experience: 2 years to 4 years
Work Environment
E-Mail
Telephone Conversations
Indoors, Environmentally Controlled
Face-to-Face Discussions with Individuals and Within Teams
Contact With Others
Work With or Contribute to a Work Group or Team
Spend Time Sitting
